scope: Actual screenshot socket handler, real Qt GPU current viewport, requested-size rerender with unchanged camera and logical overlay layout. Eight finite image outputs plus two literal argument refusals; no full platform GPU parity, arbitrary styles, line-guide depth or OS-window/chrome capture claim.
fixture_publication: Original Scene/Mesh/Dimension/TextLabel/Guide/SectionPlane/GeoPath/GeoPoint constructors seed an input IGZ. Selected annotation membership is declared fixture publication, not a UI selection claim. Active edit uses actual begin_group_edit. No expected render values authored.
source_context: Actual xcb/Xvfb/software GL if needed; source _gl/_program/context/FBO required valid. Fixed logical widget800x600, DPR1, camera aspect comes from actual resizeGL. Ordinary current-camera frame required before requests. Offscreen-without-GL refused, never used as render oracle.

live_depth_law.rule: Export paint returns before normal depth snapshot reset/capture. Logical committed annotation overlays use retained live depth snapshot, not export target depth. Snap/hover rubber bands excluded; committed selection ink retained.

path_scope: Raw source reply path retained. Native response must be an actual existing encoded viewport PNG under its real temporary directory; file content/extent observations are independent, never copied from source. Encoded PNG compressor bytes are diagnostic; decoded RGBA is strict.
not_claimed: whole screenshot parity before actual native comparison
screen chrome or UI control pixels
